============================================================

                        CLEAN GLIDES
               WINDOWS INSTALLATION GUIDE

============================================================

1. INSTALLATION
------------------------------------------------------------

Format:        VST3
Architectures: @ARCHS@ (Windows 10 or 11)
               Your DAW automatically loads the matching build.
Requirements:  A VST3-compatible DAW.

OPTION A - INSTALLER SCRIPT (RECOMMENDED)

  1. Close your DAW.
  2. Extract the whole ZIP archive
     (right-click it, then "Extract All...").
     Do not run the installer from inside the ZIP.
  3. Double-click "Install.bat".
  4. Accept the administrator prompt. Windows needs it to
     write to the system VST3 folder.
  5. Restart your DAW and rescan your plugins if needed.

  The script copies "Clean Glides.vst3" to:

       C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3

  An existing version is replaced.

  On a regular x64 PC, only the x64 build is installed.
  On an ARM PC, every build is installed, because most DAWs
  on ARM PCs are x64 programs that need the x64 build.

OPTION B - MANUAL INSTALLATION

  1. Close your DAW.
  2. Extract the whole ZIP archive.
  3. OPTIONAL - remove the build you do not need. It only
     takes a little disk space and is never used. What
     matters is the type of your DAW, not only your PC.

     Check your PC: open Settings > System > About and read
     "System type".

     x64-based processor:
       Delete the folder
       "Clean Glides.vst3\Contents\arm64-win"

     ARM-based processor:
       You need to confirm the architecture used by your
       DAW. To do so: in Task Manager, open the "Details"
       tab, right-click a column header, choose
       "Select columns" and tick "Architecture" if it is
       available. If your DAW shows "ARM64", you may delete
       "Clean Glides.vst3\Contents\x86_64-win". If it shows
       "x64", you may delete the other folder:
       "Clean Glides.vst3\Contents\arm64-win".

     If you are unsure, keep both: it works either way.
  4. Copy the entire "Clean Glides.vst3" folder to:

       C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3

  5. If prompted, choose "Replace" to overwrite an older
     version, and confirm the administrator prompt.
  6. Restart your DAW and rescan your plugins if needed.

NOTES

  - Copy the whole folder, not only the file inside it.
  - Clean Glides is not code-signed. Windows SmartScreen
    may warn you when you run "Install.bat". If you trust
    this download, choose "More info" then "Run anyway",
    or use the manual installation instead.
  - If your DAW does not find the plugin, check that its
    VST3 search paths include the folder above.
  - To uninstall, delete the folder:

       C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\Clean Glides.vst3
